name: Static site (JAMstack)
summary: Pages built ahead of time from Markdown or a headless CMS and served from a CDN; any interaction is a small island of JavaScript or a serverless function. Fast, cheap and hard to break.

avoidWhen.says: it needs live data or accounts

frontend.why: Ships HTML with no JavaScript by default; islands where interaction is needed.

backend.why: A function for the contact form or search, only if needed.

search.why: Site search when the content grows past a few dozen pages.

testing.why: Smoke tests of key pages and links.

observability.why: Only if there are functions or islands to watch.

dataStores.name: content
dataStores.purpose: Markdown files in the repository (content collections)

environments.name: staging
environments.purpose: A preview deployment per pull request

stages.name: check
stages.does: astro check and a link checker

stages.name: deploy
stages.does: Pages deploys main; previews for pull requests

notes: No server; the CDN is the host

security.auth: None for readers; the CMS or git host controls who publishes
notes: Captcha and rate limits on forms

folderLayout:
src/
  content/
  layouts/
  pages/
  components/
public/
astro.config.mjs

adrs.title: Static first

adrs.why: Fast everywhere, nothing to patch, nearly free to host.
